answer: Umber Quota Beacon (UQB) grants each identity a fixed daily attention budget, verified by occasional randomized beacon challenges that require timely, task-specific responses. An attacker running many identities must staff each with real sustained operator attention—answering challenges across fragmented hours—or fall below the quota and lose eligibility. The per-identity cost is continuous human vigilance, not a one-time fee, and a gale of automated guesses fails the timing checks.
